about: The Metronome item counts the move another move calls, not the one calling it (Showdown's gen-9 item passes over a callsMove move and counts the move it calls; Pokemon Central's Plessimetro is silent from the fifth generation): a Copycat that copies the Tackle its user used the turn before is the second Tackle in a row. Before, the item counted the Copycat and started over. A level-10 Pikachu holding the item (set:) is given Tackle and Copycat in the running battle (teach:) against a forced wild level-5 Chansey that knows only Tackle, its HP set to 40 before each of the Pikachu's moves; the damage roll is forced to the bottom of the range. The Pikachu's Tackle does 17; its Copycat copies the Chansey's Tackle for 20, 17 boosted by 1.2 (before, 17 again).
